description: This Java class 'LoanScheduleComponent' in the 'service.schedule' package manages the updating of loan repayment schedules. It contains methods for updating loan schedules based on new schedule models or installments, ensuring existing installments are replaced or added, and removing those no longer relevant. It also interacts with a LoanBalanceService to update derived fields after modifications.

classes.name: LoanScheduleComponent
classes.description: A Spring-managed component responsible for updating the loan repayment schedule, including adding, updating, and removing installments, and maintaining consistency after changes.

methods.name: updateLoanSchedule
methods.description: Updates the loan repayment schedule based on a given LoanScheduleModel, adding new installments, updating existing ones, and removing obsolete installments. Also updates dependent fields and the loan summary.

methods.name: updateLoanSchedule
methods.description: Overloaded method that updates the loan schedule directly with a list of installments, adding or updating as needed, and removing non-present installments. Also updates derived fields.

methods.name: findByInstallmentNumber
methods.description: Helper method to find a loan installment by its installment number within a collection.

methods.name: existInstallment
methods.description: Helper method to check if an installment with a given number exists within a collection of installments or schedule periods.
